convert_lerobot_to_mcap: convert LeRobot dataset episodes to MCAP files using parallel workers and timestamp mapping
create_lerobot_episodic_logger: create a LeRobotEpisodicLogger instance to write LeRobot episodes to MCAP files with image and proprioceptive keys
start_episode: start a new episode session in the LeRobotEpisodicLogger with a given episode ID
record_step: record a single step with observation data and timestamp into the current LeRobot episode
finish_episode: finish the current LeRobot episode and write all recorded data to an MCAP file
